_about: KABIL programmes, results chains and credential findings, from the research file in the org-grant-intelligence repo (which reads KABIL's annual reports). Only figures the file states are used; missing stages are left empty on purpose.

programs.name: Sustainable livelihoods project, undivided Udalguri (Axis Bank Foundation)
programs.description: 4-year livelihoods project in Udalguri and Harisinga with SHG and non-SHG families: agriculture, livestock, and MGNREGS individual beneficiary schemes such as farm ponds.

programs.name: Livelihood improvement, Mazbat block (Azim Premji Foundation)
programs.description: Small and marginal farmers in Mazbat block: agriculture and livestock interventions, training and adoption support. Ran from January 2021, concluded FY2023-24.

programs.name: Promoting livelihoods for rural poor households, Mazbat block
programs.description: Aims to raise the income of 2,000 households in selected village councils by an average of 50% of current income.

programs.name: DWIMU: Diversification with Integrated Management for the Upliftment of People's Lives
programs.description: 10,000 ST, SC and other vulnerable households, 20 VCDCs, 105 villages; convergence with Agriculture, Forest, Animal Husbandry and Fishery departments. Launched July 2024; tripartite MoU with ASRLM and BRLF.

metrics.name: Households with vegetable or horticulture plans submitted to the Agriculture Department

credential_events.notes: Single source, not checked against the MCA register
